messages.subject: Fehr-Schmidt Inequality Aversion (FSIA) model
parts:
Hi Young and Nate, 

Glad to see the 0.6.0! 

I've coded a Fehr-Schmidt model, which seems commonly used by the behavioral/neuro- economic community. Please see attached the stan file. 

btw, when initializing y_pred with '-1's, we could use:

         y_pred = rep_array(-1,N,T);

instead of the loop. But this is more about style, rather than computing speed. 

Cheers,
Lei
